chunks: “Whoever guarantees for me four things, I guarantee for him four houses in Paradise: spend and do not fear poverty; deal fairly with people from yourself; spread peace in the world; and leave disputation, even if you are right.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةً: four qualities or commitments being asked for
key_terms.أَنْفِقْ: spend generously in the way of good
key_terms.السَّلَامَ: peaceful greeting and the spreading of peace
key_terms.فَقْرًا: poverty, which one should not fear when giving

ai.seo_question: What four qualities did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام connect to houses in Paradise?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that four moral commitments lead to a promised reward in Paradise. The hadith links generosity, fairness, spreading salam, and avoiding contentious argument with spiritual success and noble character.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1711 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever guarantees me four things, I will guarantee for him four chambers in Paradise: Spend and do not fear poverty, treat people with fairness, spread peace throughout the world, and abandon arguments, even if you are right."
